title: Act Apprentice (various trades)
qualification: The minimum requirement of 50% aggregate marks in Matriculation is not applicable to candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories. Only completing the ITI course is not sufficient - candidates must be in possession of their ITI pass certificate/NTC/STC as on the date of the notification (14-07-2026).
salary: Minimum stipend for NTC/STC holders:₹9,600 per month, effective from 11-09-2025, as per G.S.R. 610(E) dated 03-09-2025 issued by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (RBE No. 116/2025). || Where one or two years' exemption is admissible under the Apprenticeship curriculum:₹10,560/month(2nd year, 10% increase) and₹11,040/month(3rd year, 15% increase). || Stipend rates are subject to revision from time to time as notified by the appropriate authority. || No hostel accommodation is provided; apprentices must make their own arrangements during training.
age_limit: Candidates must be not below 15 years and not above 24 years of age as on the closing date of application, i.e., 19-08-2026. || For children of ex-servicemen, the same age relaxation as applicable to their respective community (UR/SC/ST/OBC) will apply.
application_fee: Candidates seeking fee exemption as Economically Backward Class (EBC) must have family income of less than ₹50,000/- per annum and must upload a certificate issued on or after 01-04-2026 (Annexure-XVI). If a candidate wishes to modify or correct the online application after submission, a fee of ₹50/- is charged for each occasion; however, registration details cannot be modified.
selection_process: Selection is purely merit-based, with no written examination. The merit list for each unit is prepared using thepercentage of marks in Matriculation (minimum 50% aggregate) plus ITI marksin the relevant trade; the final panel is based on the average of the two. || For Medical Laboratory Technician (Pathology) and (Radiology), merit is based on Matriculation marks plus 12th Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) marks. || Calculation uses marks obtained inall subjectsof Matriculation/12th, not select subjects, and the average ITI marks across all semesters (or the National Trade Certificate marks). || Merit lists are prepared unit-wise, trade-wise and community-wise, in descending order of percentage, equal to the number of notified slots. || Shortlisted candidates are called forDocument Verification (DV)to the extent of 1.5 times the notified vacancies. || A candidate is considered for only one combination of Unit-Department-Trade based on merit and order of preference; once selected against a higher preference, all lower preferences are automatically cancelled. || In case of a tie in marks, the older candidate (by age) is ranked higher; if date of birth is also the same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier is ranked higher.

title: Safety Officer, Technician and More     – 40 Posts
qualification: Full-time Degree/Diploma in Mechanical/Production/Production & Industrial Engineering/Automobile/Mechatronics/Material Science/Metallurgical Engineering from an AICTE-recognized university/institute
salary: Monthly remuneration is grouped into three tiers based on the post, and it also varies slightly depending on whether the place of posting falls under A, B, or C class city classification. The consolidated figure already includes Basic Pay, DA, HRA, Conveyance, and Mobile Allowance. || The annual remuneration will increase by 4% of the consolidated remuneration after completion of every year, subject to KRCL's requirement and discretion. Additional facilities include applicable benefits under the New Labour Code-2026 (Insurance, Gratuity, Bonus), TA for official travel beyond the project area, complementary Railway Pass for duty travel, rest house/hotel reimbursement while on duty, 15 days of fully earned leave per 6 months (accumulable but not encashable), and 8 days of Casual Leave per year. No overtime allowance is paid, as the fixed monthly remuneration already accounts for occasional extra working hours. || Also Read: Calculate your exact in-hand Salary in 10 seconds - Calculate Now
age_limit: Candidates for most posts must not exceed 40 years of age as on 01 July 2026, with the standard government relaxation applying to OBC-NCL and SC/ST candidates. Here is the exact age criteria as stated in the notification. || The upper age limit for most posts isnot more than 40 years as on 01.07.2026. || For the Technician (Welder) post, the age limit is40 years as on 30.06.2026. || Age relaxation of 3 years is given to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates and 5 years to SC/ST candidates, if applying against the post reserved for their respective category. || Age relaxation for Ex-servicemen isdiscretionary.
application_fee: The KRCL notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment. Candidates only need to prepare the application form and required documents to attend the walk-in interview; however, selected candidates are required to execute an indemnity bond of Rs. 50,000 in favour of Konkan Railway Corporation Limited on a stamp paper of Rs. 100 or more.
selection_process: Selection is entirely through a walk-in interview process, with an optional elimination round if the number of candidates is high, followed by a final interview and merit list. Here are the steps as described in the notification. || Candidates arrive at the venue and register with the nominated KRCL official between09:00 hrs and 12:00 hrson the interview date for their post. || AGroup Discussion (GD) or another elimination round, such as a written test, may be introduced depending on the number of candidates; only those who clear this round proceed further. || Candidates are interviewed by anominated Committee, and amerit list is drawn based on interview performance, qualification, and post-qualification experience. || Thedecision of the Nominated Committee of KRCL is final and binding. || After preliminary screening of applications submitted in person, only provisionally eligible candidates will be interviewed . Candidates should come prepared to stay for a minimum of 2 days, if required, at their own cost, as no train/bus fare or TA/DA will be paid by the Corporation .

title: Assistant Manager (Mechanical)
qualification: Candidates must hold a full-time Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering/Technology in Mechanical, Production, Production & Industrial, Manufacturing, Mechanical/Railways, Mechatronics & Automobile, or a combination of the above disciplines in part or whole. || UR/EWS candidates (and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD candidates applying against unreserved posts) need afirst-class degree or a minimum of 60% marks. || Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD, as applicable) need aminimum of 50% marksfor consideration against reserved posts. || The degree must be recognized by AICTE and awarded by a University established under an Act of Parliament/State legislature, or a Deemed University under the UGC Act, 1956. Sections A & B of the Institution of Engineers (India) examination, treated as equivalent to a degree by the Government of India, are also accepted. || If the marksheet does not show a class/division or percentage, candidates must submit the conversion formula issued by their university; if no such formula exists, an authorized undertaking is required, and a CGPA of 6 on a 10-point scale will then be treated as 60%.
age_limit: For the Mechanical discipline, the post is identified suitable for candidates with locomotor disability categories OA, OL, OAL, BL, Leprosy Cured, and Acid Attack Victims, with functional classifications S, ST, BN, W, SE, MF, C, R, W & RW. Persons with disabilities belonging to an identified category can apply even where no vacancy is specifically reserved for them, and will be considered by the general standard of merit.

title: Technician     – 6557 Posts
qualification: For Technician Grade-I Signal, candidates need a Bachelor of Science in Physics/Electronics/Computer Science/Information Technology/Instrumentation, a three-year diploma in Engineering, or a Degree in Engineering in these streams. For most Technician Grade-III posts, candidates need Matriculation /SSLC plus ITI from NCVT/SCVT or Matriculation/SSLC plus Course Completed Act Apprenticeship in the relevant trade (such as Fitter, Welder, Electrician, Machinist, Carpenter, or Blacksmith, depending on the post applied for).
salary: Candidates curious about RRB Technician in-hand salary should note that pay depends on the post and pay level assigned. Technician Grade-I Signal carries a higher starting pay than Technician Grade-III posts, as shown below. || Selected candidates will undergo training wherever prescribed, during which only a stipend is paid rather than full pay.
age_limit: Candidates from reserved categories get standard relaxation in the upper age limit: 5 years for SC/ST , 3 years for OBC-NCL , and additional relaxation for PwBD candidates (10 years for UR/EWS, 13 years for OBC-NCL, 15 years for SC/ST). Ex-servicemen get age relaxation equal to their length of service plus 3 years (UR/EWS), 6 years (OBC-NCL), or 8 years (SC/ST) after deducting service length from their actual age.
application_fee: The application fee for RRB Technician CEN 02/2026 differs by candidate category and is partially refundable for those who appear in the CBT. General category candidates pay more than reserved categories, with both fee structures eligible for partial refund upon attending the exam. || Fee payment is accepted only through online mode - internet banking, debit/credit cards, or UPI. Applications submitted without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected, so candidates must pay the fee before 31 July 2026.
selection_process: Candidates often ask how RRB selects Technicians, and the answer is a three-stage process based purely on merit. The recruitment involves a Computer Based Test (CBT), Document Verification (DV), and a Medical Examination, with shortlisting at each stage determined by performance in the previous one. || Computer Based Test (CBT):A single CBT of 90 minutes with 100 questions and negative marking of 1/3rd mark per wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks are 40% (UR/EWS), 30% (OBC-NCL/SC), and 25% (ST). || Document Verification (DV):Candidates are shortlisted at a 1:1 ratio against vacancies based on CBT merit, RRB-wise. Original documents must be produced; no extra time is given for missing certificates. || Medical Examination (ME):Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities as per the medical standard (A3, B1, B2, or C1) prescribed for the specific post. || Based on typical RRB recruitment cycles, CBT is expected a few months after the application closes, followed by DV and medical examination in subsequent phases - though exact dates will be announced on official RRB websites.

age_limit: The general age band is 20 to 33 years. The date of birth limits above already include community age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC-NCL.

selection_process: Selection for the post of Section Controller involves the following stages: || Computer Based Test (CBT):Single stage, 120 minutes, 100 questions, with negative marking of 1/3 mark per wrong answer || Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT):Shortlisting to the extent of 8 times the vacancies; candidates must secure a minimum T-Score of 42 marks in each test battery to qualify; no negative marking || Document Verification (DV):Shortlisting at 1:1 ratio of vacancies, based on 70% weightage to CBT and 30% weightage to CBAT || Medical Examination:As per Medical Standard A-2

qualification: (A) Essential: || Passed 12th (+2 stage) or its equivalent examination with not less than 50% marks in the aggregate for NTPC categories. The 50% marks condition is not required for SC/ST/Ex-servicemen/Persons with Disabilities (PWD) candidates, and for candidates possessing a qualification higher than the essential minimum qualification. || OR Matriculation plus Course Completed Act Apprentice approved by NCVT/SCVT for technical categories. || OR Matriculation plus ITI approved by NCVT/SCVT for Technical Categories. || Candidates must additionally hold a Degree/Diploma/Certificate in the relevant cultural talent for which the notification is issued, from a Government-recognized institute. || Note: Persons appointed to the category of Clerk cum Typist should acquire Typing Proficiency of 30 wpm in English or 25 wpm in Hindi within a period of two years from the date of appointment, and until such time their appointment to this category will be provisional.

selection_process: There will be negative marking in the written test; 1/3rd of the marks allotted for the objective type question will be deducted for every wrong answer. || The medium for the written examination is either Hindi or English. || The minimum qualifying percentage is 40% for both Stage-I and Stage-II separately. Only candidates qualifying Stage-I are eligible for the Stage-II recruitment process. || Candidates to the extent of only 5 times the number of vacancies, in order of merit, who have scored a minimum of 40% marks out of 50 in the written examination, will be called for practical demonstration and marking of testimonials/prizes. The merit list of the written examination will be the criterion for shortlisting. || After clearing Stage-I and Stage-II, and on the recommendation of the Recruitment Committee, the candidate will be sent for medical examination at a Railway Hospital, as per order of merit. The final panel will be drawn as per merit according to the marks obtained out of 100. || It is mandatory for the candidate to be declared fit in the prescribed medical category by the Railway Medical Authority, as applicable for the offered post. || The Written Test will consist of objective type multiple-choice questions covering General Knowledge, General Science, General Mathematics, Knowledge of General English & Hindi Language, Professional Knowledge, Reasoning, and Aptitude. The duration of the Written Test is 60 minutes, with a qualifying percentage of 40%. || Assessment of talent will be in the relevant cultural discipline, based on Practical Demonstration and Testimonials/Prizes examination. || The time and venue of the written test, practical demonstration, and document verification will be fixed by the Railways and intimated to eligible candidates in due course. No request for postponement of the written test, practical demonstration, or document verification will be entertained under any circumstances. || Note: The written examination and proficiency test shall be held at Maligaon, Guwahati.
